name: SFT Baseline
goal: Run a single-round SFT-oriented data pipeline using Hugging Face datasets artifacts.
input_description: Input is an existing Hugging Face Dataset or DatasetDict save_to_disk directory.
output_description: Produce cleaned and optionally expanded datasets, a stub model artifact, an lm-eval gsm8k score, and an experiment report.

budget.notes: V0.1 only runs one experiment round.
